agent-guidance-maintenance.route: Adopt, add, audit, refresh, or update Agent Guidance Kit content

ai-slop-detector.route: Audit repository artifacts for evidence-backed quality defects

architecture-review.route: Review architecture and compare Keep, Evolve, Replace, or Greenfield options

bootstrap-project.route: Inspect a project and propose an approval-gated guidance adoption

code-review.route: Review a diff, branch, subsystem, or repository for concrete defects

documentation-review.route: Verify and update documentation against implementation and build truth

harness-adaptation.route: Adapt canonical guidance to the active agent harness

parallel-multi-agent.route: Partition independent work among bounded concurrent workers

quality-hardening.route: Find and close a bounded set of correctness gaps with regression coverage

reduce-code-size.route: Reduce code size while preserving behavior and contracts

rules-and-skills-audit.route: Audit guidance overlap, conflicts, routing, and consolidation opportunities

security-review.route: Review security boundaries, authority, secrets, and sensitive data flows

skill-authoring.route: Create or revise a project-local agent skill

skill-evaluation.route: Measure whether a skill improves routing or task outcomes

skill-optimizer.route: Reduce guidance context cost without weakening behavior

skill-reviewer.route: Review skill content for missing domain depth and practical usefulness

systematic-debugging.route: Diagnose an observed failure and find its root cause before fixing it
